DECLARE
 v_lov boolean;
BEGIN
IF :ctrl_block2.s_drive_id is NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT distinct a.drive_id
 INTO :ctrl_block2.s_drive_id
 FROM new_donor_temp a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c 
 WHERE c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id 
 and a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and ( c.name like '%'||:ctrl_block2.s_drive_id||'%'
 or a.drive_id = :ctrl_block2.s_drive_id ) 
 and trunc(a.insert_date) 
 between :ctrl_block2.start_date and :ctrl_block2.end_date;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found then
 show_error('11109');
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
--message(sqlerrm);pause;
 v_lov := show_lov('lov_drive_id');
 IF NOT v_lov THEN 
 Raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK2_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block2_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK2.LAST_NAME' then
 item_change('ctrl_block2.last_name',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK2.START_DATE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block2.start_date',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK2.END_DATE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block2.end_date',action);
 end if;

 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block2.pb_retrieve',ENABLED,property_true);
 else
 set_item_property('ctrl_block2.pb_retrieve',ENABLED,property_false);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA2
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data2 IS
 q_str varchar2(1000);
 lov_lmt varchar2(10);
 q_hits number;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 -- Added by Kishore on 08/19/2011. SCR 18384
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 q_str := ' DONOR_ID = DONOR_ID ';
 if :ctrl_block2.last_name is not null then
 q_str :=q_str||' and ( upper(last_name) like ''%'||:ctrl_block2.last_name||'%'' ';
 q_str :=q_str||' or upper(first_name) like ''%'||:ctrl_block2.last_name||'%'' ';
 q_str :=q_str||' or soundex(last_name) = soundex(:ctrl_block2.last_name) ';
 q_str :=q_str||' or soundex(first_name) = soundex(:ctrl_block2.last_name) ';
 q_str :=q_str||' or donor_id = :ctrl_block2.last_name) ';

 end if;

 if (:ctrl_block2.start_date is not null or 
 :ctrl_block2.end_date is not null ) 
 then
 if :ctrl_block2.start_date is not null and
 :ctrl_block2.end_date is not null 
 then
 -- Added time zone changes to "insert_date" field. Changed by Kishore on 08/19/2011. SCR 18384

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select to_char(a.insert_date,'MM-DD-RR') insdate, a.drive_id, c.name, a.insert_date 
from new_donor_temp a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c 
where c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id 
 and a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and ( c.name like '%'||:ctrl_block2.s_drive_id||'%'
 or a.drive_id = :ctrl_block2.s_drive_id ) 
 and trunc(a.insert_date) between :ctrl_block2.start_date and :ctrl_block2.end_date
 order by 4,2,3
